tutorials.text:
# Slay the Spire II Setup

This guide covers installing the mod, preparing a player YAML, generating a
multiworld and connecting to it. Check the release notes for the game versions
supported by the release you are installing.

We recommend the **beta branch**, where Terairk mainly develops and tests the mod.
The main branch remains supported, but receives little, if any, gameplay testing;
compatibility is assessed primarily through compile-time checks and player bug reports.
Beta branch updates can temporarily break compatibility until the mod is updated.

## Install the mod

You need Slay the Spire II and [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295)
(version 0.6.0 or newer). Install only one copy of the Archipelago mod: either
Steam Workshop or a manual installation.

### Steam Workshop

1. If you previously installed manually, move `mods/Archipelago` outside the
   game's `mods` directory or remove that copy.
2. Subscribe to [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295)
   and [Slay the Spire II Archipelago](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748826296).
3. Wait for Steam to finish downloading both mods, then start the game.

### Manual installation

1. Unsubscribe from the Archipelago Workshop item if you were using it. Keep
   RitsuLib installed separately.
2. Download `Archipelago.zip` from the release you want to play.
3. In Steam, open Slay the Spire 2's **Browse Local Files** action.
4. Create `mods/Archipelago` inside that game directory and extract the ZIP's
   contents into it. This works with Windows and Linux archive tools.
5. Confirm that `Archipelago.dll`, `Archipelago.json`, the PCK and the `lib/` and
   `data/` directories are directly inside `mods/Archipelago`, without an extra
   nested `Archipelago` folder. Keep all packaged dependencies and both game
   variants together: the root DLL is the loader.
6. Start the game.

The loader selects the build for your installed game version. Later patches on a
supported major/minor line can use its newest earlier build, with a log warning.
An earlier patch or a new major/minor line needs a matching mod release. Consult
that release's notes rather than assuming a newer game update is supported.

## Prepare your player YAML

The easiest and recommended way to make your YAML is the
[YAML Builder](https://sts2ap.terairk.dev/#/builder) on the beta Slay the Spire II
Archipelago website, which has the newest options first. The main site,
[sts2ap.net](https://sts2ap.net/#/builder), gets them later. The builder walks through
every option and downloads a finished YAML. The mod's **Mod Website & YAML Builder**
main-menu button opens the beta site's builder.

Alternatively, download `Spire2-template.yaml` from the same release and edit it
by hand, or use the Archipelago Launcher's **Options Creator**. Set `name` to the
Archipelago slot name you want to use and review the options before generation.

Each participant supplies one YAML. For custom characters, everyone who needs
those characters must install the corresponding character mods; test their
compatibility before a full multiworld.

If a slot's character mod is missing or broken, you can still connect after a
warning. Every character's checks and victories then also count for each missing
character. **Defect** is always playable in that case: it uses its own items if
your YAML includes Defect, and otherwise the first missing character's items.
Checkpoints saved with a different set of mods may not load; start a new run if
one fails. As a last resort, the dev console command
`ap_release_missing <character> confirm` sends all of a missing character's
remaining checks; it is disabled in race rooms.

## Generate a multiworld

**You must generate using Archipelago Launcher v0.6.7 or newer.** This requirement
applies to the Launcher used for generation; the Launcher is not required merely
to play the StS2 mod and connect to an existing session.

1. Install [Archipelago Launcher](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)
   v0.6.7 or newer.
2. Download the `.apworld` asset from the same mod release. Depending on the
   release, it is named `spire2.apworld` or `spire2-<version>.apworld`.
3. Install that file in the Launcher with **Install APWorld**, as Archipelago's
   guide to [playing with custom worlds](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup/en#playing-with-custom-worlds) describes.
4. Use **Browse Files** in the Launcher, open `Players`, and put the participants'
   YAML files there.
5. Select **Generate**. The resulting multiworld ZIP is written to `output`.

Install a newer APWorld before generating a new multiworld when updating it;
installing the file alone does not change a seed that was already generated.

To play online, upload the generated ZIP at [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg/)
and create a room, or use your preferred Archipelago server. Keep the room's
server address, port and any password for connecting.

## Connect and play

1. Start Slay the Spire II with the Archipelago mod and RitsuLib enabled.
2. Select **Connect to Archipelago** on the main menu.
3. Enter the session's server address/port, your YAML's slot name and any password.
4. Connect, then follow the mod's character/run selection.

Avoid unrelated gameplay mods when troubleshooting. All players sharing an
in-game multiplayer lobby should use the same Archipelago mod version.

## Troubleshooting

- **The game loads the wrong mod copy:** check both Workshop subscriptions and
  `mods/Archipelago`; keep only the installation you intend to use.
- **The loader rejects the game version:** check the supported main branch and beta branch versions
  in your mod release's notes and select the corresponding game branch.
- **Generation does not recognize Slay the Spire II:** install the release's
  APWorld in the Launcher you are actually using, verify it is v0.6.7+, and retry.
- **Connection reports a version mismatch:** check that generation used the APWorld
  supplied with the mod release. A compatibility warning needs investigation;
  changing the installed APWorld will not rewrite an existing session.

readme.text: # Slay the Spire 2 Archipelago Archipelago Client & APWorld for STS2 # Download the Latest Playable Release [Here](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/releases/latest) > [!IMPORTANT] > We recommend the **beta branch**, where Terairk mainly develops and tests the mod. > The main branch remains supported, but receives little, if any, gameplay testing; > compatibility is assessed primarily through compile-time checks and player bug reports. > Beta branch updates can temporarily break compatibility until the mod is updated. > > The client contains exact builds for the main branch **v0.107.1** and beta branch > **v0.113.0** game versions. ## 1.0 Development onwards This mod is currently in 2.0 stage and is practically feature-parity with the AP from the StS1. While there are some edge case bugs, most people have successfully played an Archipelago with this world and had no issues. > [!WARNING] > The mod only supports English at the moment, but as we understand localization better, we can work with the community to support more languages # Installing the Mod See the [setup guide](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/blob/setup-docs-do-not-delete/docs/multiplayer_setup.md) for installation, YAML configuration, generation and connection instructions. There are two ways to install the mod, detailed below. ## Steam Workshop Subscribe to the mod on the [steam workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748826296). Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. ## Manual installation 1. Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. 2. Download `Archipelago.zip` from the [Releases](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/releases/latest) section of the repo 3. Go to your Slay the Spire II directory (In Steam, click "Browse Local Files") 4. If a folder called `mods` does not exist, create it 5. Put `Archipelago.zip` in `mods`, then extract it into the archive program's default `Archipelago` directory - If you've done this step correctly, `mods/Archipelago/` contains the loader DLL, common dependencies, the PCK, and `lib/0.107.1/` plus `lib/0.113.0/`. Keep that directory structure intact. - The bundled `spire2.apworld` matches this mod version. Hosts can install it through the Archipelago Launcher's **Install APWorld**; see Archipelago's guide to [playing with custom worlds](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup/en#playing-with-custom-worlds). 6. Start the game # Features ## What's Included - Card/Relic Rewards shuffled in the multiworld - Goldsanity - Campfiresanity (Progressive Rest/Smith) - Potionsanity - Saving to the AP Server, and Saving when Connection is Lost - Death Link - Shopsanity (currently playable but may lack some polish) - Interesting Filler Items - Progressive Ancients - Progressive Starter Card and Relic (ie None -> Bash -> Break) - Multiplayer Support - Traps (more will be added) - Modded Character Support > [!CAUTION] > Mods such as modded character are supported but may or may not work. I do know that 'Downfall Classic' and 'IntoTheSpireVerse' and also 'Watcher by Lamali' all work well as of the 2.0.0 release. # Special Thanks - [Archipelago.MultiClient.Net](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago.MultiClient.Net) - Platano Bailando for creating the StS 1 Archipelago that inspires this one! - [lamali292](https://github.com/lamali292) for their initial guide on creating mods for Slay the Spire 2! - [alwaysintreble](https://github.com/alwaysintreble/ArchipelagoBepInExPluginTemplate/tree/master) for their example Archipelago C# Plugin Template - [Spire Codex](https://spire-codex.com) for providing an awesome public API that helps us stay up-to-date with Slay the Spire 2 data for our item pools - All of the wonderful contributors to the project! # Roadmap You can view the current roadmap in detail [here](https://github.com/users/dlueben1/projects/1) > [!IMPORTANT] > Multiplayer is going to be **complex**, and will only be started on when **everything else is very stable**. Thanks for understanding!

notes.text:
> [!WARNING] > Both Slay the Spire II and this Archipelago Mod are in active development. As such, while this _is_ playable, expect there to be bugs and limited features. We appreciate your playtesting! > [!IMPORTANT] > **Play on the game's beta branch.** Main-branch support is on thin ice but supported none the less: the mod still runs there, but it's largely untested and new game features might not be supported on it. ## Setup For installation, YAML configuration, generation and connection instructions, see [the Slay the Spire II setup guide](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/blob/setup-docs-do-not-delete/world/spire2/docs/setup_en.md). Archipelago **Launcher v0.6.7+** is required for generation. Install **STS2-RitsuLib 0.6.11+** separately. The newest YAML Builder is at [sts2ap.terairk.dev](https://sts2ap.terairk.dev/#/builder), and the mod's **Mod Website & YAML Builder** button opens it. [sts2ap.net](https://sts2ap.net/#/builder) gets the new options later. # Version Information - **Archipelago Client:** 2.2.0 - **APWorld:** 1.4.0 - **Slay the Spire II main branch:** v0.111.1 - **Slay the Spire II beta branch:** v0.113.1 Older game versions (0.107.1, 0.111.0 and 0.113.0) no longer get their own build, since Steam moves everyone to the latest version of their branch. Hopefully this doesn't break anything # Changelist ## Major changes ### Boons The opposite of Challenges: a new opt-in **Boons** option with helpful modifiers for every run. **Logic doesn't account for them, and they're all off by default.** - **Wayfinder:** three times per act, travel to any room in the next row, ignoring the paths. - **Second Wind:** once per act, survive a killing blow and heal 25% of your max HP. - **Ember Enchanting:** campfires let you enchant a card with a random enchantment. Uses up the campfire and needs the same Progressive Smith as upgrading. - **Compound Interest:** at the start of Acts 2 and 3, gain 20% of the gold you hold, up to 100. - **Gilded:** gain 30% more gold, including gold from AP items. - **Spring Cleaning:** after the Act 1 and Act 2 bosses, choose one: remove a card, transform a card, or upgrade 2 random cards. - **Loyal Customer:** each purchase makes the rest of that shop 15% cheaper, up to 45%. AP checks in the shop count and get the discount too. - **Campfire Brewing:** once per campfire, brew a random potion. You can still rest or upgrade afterwards. - **Endless Upgrades:** cards can be upgraded any number of times. Each upgrade adds the card's upgrade bonus again. Wayfinder and Second Wind show up as relics, so you can see how many uses are left this act. Only Compound Interest, Gilded, Loyal Customer and Endless Upgrades work in multiplayer, where the host's choice applies to the whole run. ### Sight Bonuses Sight items felt like pure hindrances, so a **second copy** of a Sight item now gives a bonus on top of undoing its Hidden option: - **Intent Sight:** start each combat with **Forewarned**: for each enemy whose attacks your Block stops completely on its turn, draw 1 more card next turn. - **Health Sight:** gain **Aged Cheese**: after defeating an Elite or a boss, raise your Max HP by 3. - **Pile Sight:** the draw pile shows cards in the order you'll draw them. - **Map Sight:** a **Scouting** list under the map legend shows your next 2 fights, your next elite and what your next 2 ? rooms will be. Rooms you can move to next say what's in them. - **Card Sight:** card rewards offer 1 more card, and Act 1 card rewards can be upgraded. The Hidden options now go up to 4 copies, and the new `sight_bonuses` option lets you leave a Sight at its normal level. **Logic counts each bonus as extra power in Act 3** when its second copy is in the pool. It's only there to give a bonus in act 3 to not influence its placements too much so you're still punished for it but also get a major upside. Also so it counts as progression so people don't skip it in shops. The Intent, Health and Card bonuses are singleplayer only. Pile and Map work in multiplayer. This is going to be a frequent thing going forwards: where somethings just aren't supported in multiplayer because they're insanely complex to work in multiplayer. ### More Bonus Items Bonus Items aren't just wax relics anymore. The new kinds: - **Relic:** a relic that stays for the whole run, from chosen pools or one specific relic. - **Enchantment:** choose a card to enchant, from a rarity pool or one named enchantment. - **Enchanted Cards:** a card reward whose cards are all enchanted. - **Max HP:** gain a set amount of max HP. - **Cards:** choose 1 of 3 cards from pools like `Regent Attack` or `Colorless Rare`, optionally upgraded, or one named card. Three new enchantments of the mod's own come with them: - **Checkbound** (Rare): +1 damage per hit and +1 Block as your character's checks pass 5, 12, 22, 36, 55 and 80% of its locations, up to +6. Singleplayer only. - **Eager** (Uncommon): the first time the card is drawn each combat, it costs 1 less until played. - **Exposing** (Uncommon): Attacks apply 1 Vulnerable to what they hit. ### Events in Any Act `events_in_any_act: true` lets events show up in any act instead of only their usual ones. Event fights and rewards aren't adjusted for the act you meet them in. Singleplayer only. ### Keyboard only and controller support - AP buttons (pickers, run recap, Past AP Runs) can now be pressed with Space, Enter or controller A. Before this you couldn't even start an AP run from the checkpoint picker without a mouse. - The AP shop page works with keyboard and controller, and the page buttons switch with the game's tab keys (Q/F, LB/RB). - L3 opens the AP Loot menu when Steam Input is off. ### YAML Builder The Checks & Rewards step was way too long, so the builder now has separate **Checks**, **Shops**, **Item Pool** and **Boons** steps. The Boons step marks which boons are solo only, and Blitz Merchant Chance moved there. ---
Full details ### Logic and generation - The **Use New Logic** option is gone; new logic is always used. Old logic is only kept as the automatic fallback for a singleplayer world with floor, gold and potion checks all off. - Sight items are deprioritized and skip progression balancing, so generation treats them more like a nice surprise. - Shop Card, Shop Colorless Card, Shop Relic and Shop Potion Slots skip progression balancing; they only add a little to logic each. - New **Sights** item group, so `!hint Sights` finds a way out of a Hidden challenge. It also works in `local_items` and `start_hints`. - The **Gold** item group no longer includes One Gold and Five Gold, so `!hint Gold` doesn't waste a hint on filler. - Universal Tracker keeps the slot's Sight Bonuses when it regenerates a slot. ### Cards, relics and rewards - Each Combat, Elite and Boss Gold item now counts as its own gold gain, so relics like Dragon Fruit trigger once per item instead of once per claim. One and Five Gold filler still count as a single gain. - Spring Cleaning's choice after a boss now removes the other options once you take one. ### Website and YAML - Item Pool: only wax relics are shown in sepia; the other Bonus Item kinds keep their colours. - Sight Bonuses question in Challenges. ### Fixes and other changes - The character tracker now fills in for the character that's actually selected when you open character select, instead of the first button (usually Ironclad). - Supports main **0.111.1** and beta **0.113.1**. The Dread Dominion tooltip on the boss icon lays out properly again on 0.113.1.
## Version compatibility Works on previous multiworld versions. Use the updated APWorld and client together. Boons, Sight Bonuses, the new Bonus Items and Events in Any Act need both. Seeds generated with APWorld 1.3.0 get every Sight Bonus with client 2.2.0 once a second copy of a Sight arrives. Everyone in a multiplayer lobby should use the same client version and game branch. ## Known Issues/Limitations - **Main branch:** largely untested and gets no new features. Main-branch multiplayer will stop being supported in a future release. - Dread Mode: a Double Boss Ascension Down that arrives during Act 3 removes the second boss but keeps its Dominion until the boss fight; after a reload the first boss's Dominion applies. - In multiplayer, AP menu rewards can only be claimed outside combat; Death Fragments are disabled. **Anytime** Ancient rewards are recommended. - Hidden Cards still shows each card's type and frame colour, and you can work a card out from the energy it spends or what it does when played. - Several Boons, three Sight Bonuses, Checkbound and Events in Any Act are singleplayer only.
